# pebblekit

[![build passing](https://badges.example.test/ci.svg)](https://ci.example.test/pebblekit) A set of tiny command-line tools for tiny scripts.

## Install

```
npm install --global pebblekit
```

## Features

- Zero dependencies
- Works offline
- Every tool is under 200 lines

## Options

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--quiet` | Print nothing on success |
| `--json` | Machine-readable output |
| `--root <dir>` | Run relative to a directory |
